label: PARTICIPATION_2: In the proposition-2 projection, Participates x one marks x participating in the…
definition: In the proposition-2 projection, Participates x one marks x participating in the designated One. It is a bare directed attribution relation: the received-unity and nonidentity commitments are in the statement, not built into this definition. No spatial parts, efficient production, shared genus or Platonic Form classification follows.
note: The primary Lean locator names the existing shared Vocabulary.Participates field on the SAME Entity/Quality dictionary used by the Proclus projection. Its second argument one is interpreted as the designated One, not silently as a Platonic Form. TruthCore.Greek.Proclus.ElementsTheology.ParticipantUnityContrast is the separate statement constraining that field by received unity and nonidentity; it is not the relation's definition. Sharing an interface proves no historical or philosophical equivalence between Proclus and Plato. A fuller account of how participation occurs remains open.

formal_gap.meaning: Vocabulary.Participates x f is the shared participation relation of the Forms vocabulary. In the Proclus proposition-2 projection, Participates x one says that x participates in the designated One. Read there, it is a bare directed attribution relation; the received-unity and nonidentity commitments are in the constraining statement ParticipantUnityContrast, not in the relation.
examples: Elements of Theology prop. 2: whatever participates in the One is both one and not-one; each such participant x stands in Participates x one.
exclusions: Spatial parthood, efficient production, membership in a shared genus, or classification under a Platonic Form: none follows from the relation (DISAMB-PROCLUS-UNITY-PARTICIPATION).
Identity with the One: nonidentity is a separate commitment of the statement.
open_obligations: Sharing the interface with Plato's Forms vocabulary proves no historical or philosophical equivalence between Proclus and Plato.
A fuller account of how participation occurs remains open.
No formalization candidate: participation is taken as primitive in this vocabulary.
